name: Greg
source: The Prime Minister of Carnea. He's the true culprit behind the king's illness and the one who ordered Rizel to administer the medicine. Eight years ago, he was also the mastermind behind Claude's downfall and the one who orchestrated the king's conspiracy to eliminate Claude, whom he considered a rival at the time.
